title: Block Library (Style Guide)
description: Examples of every block type used to build web pages from JSON files

blocks.heading: Block library
blocks.lead: Every block type supported by the system, with usage examples — copy the JSON from content/pages/_styleguide.json and use it directly

blocks.heading: notice
blocks.lead: Notice box — tone: info | warn | success
blocks.title: This is a notice block
blocks.body: Use it to highlight important messages, such as cautions, terms of service or temporary announcements

blocks.heading: rich-text
blocks.lead: Long text: use paragraphs (safe) or html (source must be trusted)
paragraphs: Enter text as an array of paragraphs in paragraphs. The system escapes special characters automatically, so it is safe when content comes from a CMS or users
If you need full HTML (lists, bold text, links), use the html field instead, but make sure the content comes only from trusted sources
By default the width is limited to 78 characters for readability. Set width to full for full width

blocks.heading: card-grid
blocks.lead: Content cards arranged in a grid — the most frequently used block (columns: 2, 3 or 4)

items.title: Card with an icon
items.body: Set icon to an id from the sprite, such as i-book, i-file, i-people
items.meta: The meta field sits at the bottom

items.title: Clickable card
items.body: If href is set, the whole card becomes a link with a hover effect. Set action to show a button at the bottom of the card

items.title: Plain card
items.body: Icon and href are optional, leaving just the heading and content

blocks.heading: feature-list
blocks.lead: Icon + heading + description arranged in a row, suitable for summarizing highlights or features

items.title: Item heading 1
items.body: A short description following the heading

items.title: Item heading 2
items.body: A short description following the heading

items.title: Item heading 3
items.body: A short description following the heading

items.title: Item heading 4
items.body: A short description following the heading

items.title: Dictionary
items.body: External link, opens in a new tab

blocks.heading: stat-row
blocks.lead: Statistics figures; the number of columns adjusts automatically to screen width

blocks.heading: link-list
blocks.lead: List of documents/links with file type and date, suitable for download and announcement pages

items.title: Item with a custom icon
items.desc: Set icon to replace the default file icon

blocks.lead: Template T2 long content divided into sections — an automatic "On this page" table of contents appears when there are 3 or more headings (sticky at the side on large screens, moved to the top on mobile)
intro: Intro paragraph, slightly larger than body text, used to summarize the page

sections.heading: Section with paragraphs
paragraphs: Each section has paragraphs as a list of paragraphs
The second paragraph of the same section

sections.heading: Section using HTML
sections.html: Use the field html when you need bold text, links or tables — include only trusted content

groups.heading: Group with an icon and description
groups.desc: The group description (desc) is shown below the group name

blocks.heading: table
blocks.lead: Data table. The first column automatically becomes the row header, and the table scrolls horizontally on small screens
blocks.caption: Sample table — columns are the table headers, rows is an array of arrays

blocks.heading: steps
blocks.lead: Process steps; the system numbers them automatically

blocks.heading: two-column
blocks.lead: Text paired with an image; swap sides with imageSide: left
paragraphs: Enter text as an array in paragraphs, the same as rich-text
On mobile screens it stacks vertically automatically, with the text always above and the image below

blocks.heading: faq
blocks.lead: Frequently asked questions that open/close on click (components.js binds the events automatically)

items.q: Do I need to give a block an id?
items.a: It is optional, but if set, anchor links can point to that section, and the faq block also uses the id to generate the ids of its answers

items.q: How do I change a section's background color?
items.a: Set variant to alt for a white background. Without it, the background is the theme's paper color

items.q: Can I add a new block type?
items.a: Yes. Write a render function in assets/js/blocks.js and register it in BLOCKS at the end of the file

blocks.heading: contact-info
blocks.lead: Contact information. Phone numbers and emails automatically become tel: / mailto: links

blocks.heading: cta-band
blocks.body: Call-to-action bar, placed at the end of a page to guide users onward
